title: Mandaluyong: Purchase of 27 hybrid cars aboveboard, won't be used for personal trips
summary: In a statement posted on Facebook, Mandaluyong City Public Information Office said they acknowledge public concerns regarding the acquisition of service vehicles for its 27 villages.
